prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray/sunless tanning or UV tanning (beds/booths)? Also what part of Columbus are you in (neighborhood or ZIP) and any other preferences (budget, appointment vs walk-in)?

If you want a quick answer right now, I’ll give guidance plus what I generally recommend when picking the “best” salon:

- If safety is a priority: go with a professional spray/sunless salon. It avoids UV risks and gives a more predictable result. Look for salons that use reputable solutions (Norvell, VersaSpa, Mystic) and have trained/ certified technicians.
- If you want UV tanning: pick a place with modern, well-maintained high-pressure beds, clear maintenance records, good ventilation, and staff who perform skin-type assessments and patch tests.
- How to pick the best in Columbus:
  - Search Google Maps and Yelp for “tanning salon” + your neighborhood; filter by 4+ stars and read recent reviews (last 6–12 months).
  - Look for certifications, photos of the facility, and testimonials about cleanliness and technician skill.
  - Call and ask: what brands of spray solution or bed models they use, technician training, sanitation protocol, pricing/packages, and whether they require patch tests.
  - Check social media (Instagram) to see before/after photos and technician work.
  - Compare cost-per-session vs package deals — packages often give much better value.

If you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP and whether you prefer spray or UV, I’ll list the top-rated salons in Columbus with addresses, phone numbers, specialties, and recent review highlights.
